proceedings.supporting_quote: On 24 February 2011, the applicant initiated proceedings before the administrative court, seeking the annulment of the sale of Viva TV-Radio Viva.
On an appeal by the applicant, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court upheld that decision on 9 December 2014.
On 7 February 2011, the applicant initiated proceedings before the administrative court, contesting the actions of the Fund concerning the tendering of Viva TV-Radio Viva
On 7 July 2015, following an appeal by the applicant, the General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court... annulled the Fund’s decision.
On 25 January 2016, the Supreme Administrative Court rejected the Fund’s request for rectification
On 18 April 2016, the Fund notified the applicant of a decision taken on 27 October 2015 regarding the impossibility of enforcing the judgment.
On 30 June 2017, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court granted the request... and annulled the sale in question.
On 5 September 2017, the Fund responded... the annulment decision could not be enforced due to legal and practical impossibilities
On 11 September 2017, the applicant lodged an individual application with the Constitutional Court... the Constitutional Court declared the application inadmissible.
